checkedAlternates.risk: MMP produces proportional overall seat totals.
checkedAlternates.resolution: MMP combines single-member district plurality seats with compensatory party-list seats (group-1), unlike pure party-list PR (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: STV achieves proportional representation in multi-member districts.
checkedAlternates.resolution: STV uses ranked candidate ballots without party lists (group-2), unlike party-list PR systems (group-3).
